body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-17 06:26Z; my own miss). When I tell a worker to "park until X lands", I write X → [workers] into the current queue memory at that moment. When X lands, I wake EVERY worker parked on it in the same turn I record the landing. On 10-16 about 20:00Z I parked three clean-reviewed packages "until train-3a lands": Sol-a7bb w-e803, Sol-03d4 w-2634 and UI w-7db7. They then sat idle for about 10 h, until I found them by accident through a mailbox sequence gap. Audit check: termal_list_mailboxes, then look for any worker whose latest message is THEIRS and says READY or WAIT with no reply from me after it.
